conflicts.permit: Unless specified otherwise, all Data requested by our Apps are mandatory and failure to provide this Data may make it impossible for our Apps to provide their services.
conflicts.prohibit: Personal Data may be freely provided by the User, or, in case of Usage Data, collected automatically when using our apps.
conflicts.situation: A user provides requested personal data (other than usage data) when using the apps where no specification is given about whether it is mandatory.
conflicts.reason: One sentence states that unless specified otherwise, all requested data is mandatory, whereas the other states personal data may be freely provided, creating a direct conflict on default voluntariness.
